// TS §12.5: "the no-double-booking test races 5 reservations from separate processes with their own connections,
// which exercises the transaction and index (concurrent HTTP calls into one synchronous connection would pass
// without them)." This is that test: a real file-backed database, 5 real OS processes, no mocked concurrency.
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { promisify } from "node:util";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { insertItem } from "../src/features/loans/items.repository.ts";
import { openDb } from "../src/platform/db.ts";
import { migrate } from "../src/platform/migrate.ts";
import { insertUser } from "../src/platform/users.repository.ts";

const run = promisify(execFile);
const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => { for (const d of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

describe("the one-active-loan-per-item invariant under real concurrency", () => {
  it("lets exactly one of 5 simultaneously-started reservations from separate processes win; the rest see the conflict, not a torn write", async () => {
    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "starter-race-")); dirs.push(dir);
    const dbPath = join(dir, "app.db");
    const db = openDb(dbPath);
    migrate(db);
    insertItem(db, { id: "race-item", name: "Contested Microscope", created_at: 0 });
    for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) insertUser(db, { id: `user${n}`, email: `user${n}@example.test`, role: "member", password_hash: "x", created_at: 0 });
    db.close();

    const worker = join(import.meta.dirname, "fixtures/concurrent-reserve-worker.ts");
    // All 5 processes are launched before any of them is awaited, so they genuinely overlap, not run in turn.
    const started = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => run(process.execPath, ["--import", "tsx/esm", worker, dbPath, "race-item", `user${n}`]));
    const results = await Promise.all(started.map((p) => p.then((r) => r.stdout)));

    expect(results.filter((r) => r === "ok")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r === "conflict")).toHaveLength(4);

    const check = openDb(dbPath);
    const active = check.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans WHERE item_id = 'race-item' AND status = 'active'").get() as { n: number };
    expect(active.n).toBe(1);
    check.close();
  });
});
